summary.text: Jeremie Dufault is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 15-Position 2 and the candidate for Washington State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a real estate developer and U.S. Army Reserve veteran who served on the Selah City Council.

paragraphs.text: Dufault graduated from A.C. Davis High School and served as a lieutenant colonel in the U.S. Army Reserve in Kuwait and Afghanistan.
His career experience includes working as a real estate developer.

He served on the Selah City Council, as chairman of the Yakima Veterans Board, as chairman of the Yakima Valley Technical Skill Center General Advisory Council, and as vice chairman of the Yakima County Republican Central Committee.
Dufault first served in the House of Representatives for District 15-Position 2 from 2019 to 2023, succeeding David Taylor (R), and returned to the seat on January 13, 2025.
In the 2021-2022 session he was assistant ranking minority member of the Consumer Protection & Business and Finance committees.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for the Senate seat, which has no incumbent, and no other candidate is listed for the November ballot.
